title: Audit uniform raw Gaussian common-reference admission
body:
The existing raw Gaussian caller uses a squared inverse budget against one global rounded reference. This package independently proves that an admitted `Reference.for_cap` allocation meets that caller guard for every eligible original-cell, nonwrapping dyadic block under the cap, in both directions. It derives cap-wide gauge/conditioning domination and an explicit outward residual margin below `3/8 * 2^-e`, retaining the scalar interval and normalized inverse contracts as dependencies.

The source-bound checker executes the actual reference and the unchanged raw admission prefix, stopping before circuit construction. It covers 160 legal admissions, three actual shared-weight entries and five controls. Registered Python 3.12 normal/optimized replay, metadata/source pins, and committed-byte/source-history preflight, official export integrity, and Git-free normal/optimized replay pass.

Proof and scope: `research/raw-gaussian-cap-audit/README.md`. Period-cut admission is explicit; the theorem does not promise allocation for arbitrary precision at fixed geometry. Caller carving, raw circuit/grid rounding, physical delivery and full multiplication acceptance remain outside scope. Selected frontier unchanged.

Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4202#discussioncomment-19130764

Credit Jose Manuel's reference/raw allocation, Vlado's phase-cell/circuit lineage, Jeremy Kothe's identities, Mason Hale's intervals, and ToikY/#4220's distinct scalar audit. Prepared for Brian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
